company.name: DriveNets
company.shortDescription: DriveNets offers a networking solution tailored for AI infrastructures, providing hardware, software, and cluster orchestration.
company.description:
DriveNets focuses on high-scale networking software for AI infrastructure and service providers. The company pioneered a disaggregated networking architecture that transforms the economics of large-scale networks while maximizing performance, utilization, and operational efficiency. DriveNets' powered networks are deployed by global leaders, including AT&T and Comcast. DriveNets AI Fabric delivers full-stack networking for AI infrastructures, providing the highest-performance, Ethernet-based alternative to InfiniBand. 
The company was founded in 2015 by Ido Susan and Hillel.

aiResearchSummary.text: High Speed Event Handling Mechanism in a Distributed System describes a distributed system in network clusters that delivers messages with prioritized high speed event handling across communication nodes. Orchestration of Activities of Entities Operating in a Network Cloud describes a communication system with multiple physical network elements and a server that stores predefined actions and threshold values to orchestrate activities in a network cloud. Together these works focus on distributed message handling and cloud network orchestration.
